meta.title: Broto
meta.description: Broto identifies the species from a photo, ranks the likely causes of the problem and gives you a test to confirm it at home. Then it reminds you to water.
meta.ogTitle: Broto · One photo and you know what your plant has

hero.title: One photo, and you know what your plant has
hero.lede: Take a picture of the plant. Broto gives you the species, how to care for it and, when something is wrong, the likely causes in order — with a test you can run at home to tell which one it is.
hero.soon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
hero.note: 3 days with everything unlocked, no charge at all.

blocks.label: What we spotted
blocks.body: The lower leaves yellow first and the soil is still damp from the last watering.

blocks.label: What to do
blocks.body: Let the soil dry three fingers deep before watering again, and check the pot has a hole.

blocks.label: What we spotted
blocks.body: Stretched stem and new leaves smaller than the old ones.

blocks.label: What to do
blocks.body: Move it closer to a window, with no sun hitting the leaves directly.

confirms.text: Push a finger three centimetres into the soil. If it comes out damp two days after watering, the problem is too much water — not fungus.
Look at the stem: if it stretched toward the window and the new leaf came out smaller than the old ones, it is short on light — not pests.

care.label: Light
care.note: Near a window, with no direct sun.

mock.toxicText: Keep it away from cats and dogs. This does not replace a vet.

how.title: Three taps and you are done
how.lede: No form, no questionnaire, no “what is your experience level”.

steps.title: Take the photo
steps.text: Frame the whole plant, pot and leaves. One photo only — Broto asks for no angles, no close-ups and nothing else.

steps.title: Find out
steps.text: Species, care, and if something is wrong, the likely causes in order. One photo, one answer.

steps.title: Save it
steps.text: The plant joins your list with watering, light and feeding already filled in. The reminder comes on its own.

camera.hintText:
Pot and leaves in the shot.
That is what shows the species.

why.title: A yellow leaf never has just one cause
why.first: Watered yesterday and turning yellow means too much water. Two weeks dry and turning yellow means the opposite.
why.second: Same symptom, opposite cause. So Broto never gives one verdict: it ranks the causes and hands you the test that settles it.

reminders.title: A reminder that never becomes spam
reminders.first: One reminder per plant, at the time you pick for each task. It says her name and what she needs today.
reminders.second: Late? It reminds you again. No “tip of the day”, no streak counter.

brotinho.title: For when the doubt sticks around
brotinho.text: It already knows your plants. Just ask, without explaining again which species it is and when you watered it.
brotinho.ask: Can I keep the pothos in the bathroom?
brotinho.answer: You can. It likes the humidity, but it needs indirect light — if the bathroom has no window it will stretch out and drop leaves.

items.title: No pesticide dosages
items.text: What you can do without buying anything comes first: prune the affected leaf, adjust watering, improve airflow, isolate it from the plant next to it. If a product is needed, it names the category and tells you to follow the label.

items.title: Never says a plant is edible
items.text: Never, not even if you insist. That is not the kind of mistake you can fix afterwards.

items.title: Never guesses the species
items.text: A close-up of a sick leaf sometimes does not show the plant. When that happens it says it does not know and asks for a photo of the whole plant.

items.title: Never charges for our own failure
items.text: If we cannot read your photo, the credit comes straight back and we say so on screen.

items.title: Does not replace a vet
items.text: The pet-toxicity warning shows up, always with the caveat that it is a warning, not a diagnosis.

items.title: Does not sell your data
items.text: We do not ask for precise location, we do not read your gallery — only the photo you choose to send.

pricing.title: Free to start
pricing.lede: For your first 3 days, everything in the complete plan is yours. After that, saving plants, marking them watered and getting the watering reminder still costs nothing.

closing.title: Your plant is trying to tell you something
closing.text: Take the photo and find out what. Questions before downloading? <help>Help</help> answers the common ones.
